segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: Thanks for joining, this is a made-up example interview for the test suite.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: We are Example Co, a fictional company that builds toy bakery robots, and we like a calm pace.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: There are twelve engineers on the team, split into two squads.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Great, and how do you decide what to build next?

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: A product lead writes a one page brief and the engineers choose how to build it.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: After this call there is a take-home exercise and then an onsite day.
